meta_description: Your personal Rise to Rice dashboard. Track your recycling impact, manage rewards, and stay updated.
weight_recycled_desc: The total mass of waste you've successfully diverted from landfills through our program.
total_exchanges_desc: Number of times you've visited a collection point to exchange waste for rewards.
points_earned_desc: Total reward points accumulated based on the type and weight of materials recycled.
top_material_desc: The waste category you recycle most frequently, showing your biggest impact area.
